def: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, which amended the EU AI Act to postpone high-risk obligations, add a prohibition, soften the AI literacy duty and extend SME relief to small mid-caps.
practice: Published 24 July 2026 and in force since 27 July 2026; Annex III high-risk duties now apply from 2 December 2027 and those for AI in regulated products from 2 August 2028.
